scope: Golden A commits only normal Guest Trip/P1/Day. B must inventory the entire legal Guest dataset before upload or ownership conversion.

families.A: Wired through existing normal UI; actual Native counts pending
families.B: Retain create operation, distinct Trip identity, deferred edit/dependency lineage and ordered destinations; no same-name merge or early remote shell

families.family: P1 and Core local creator state
families.localBinding: Guest vault and trip_core_pending_intents/local Core authority records
families.A: Existing P1 save/read/local Day only; no Accepted projection
families.B: Inventory complete operation/commit graph, Person/Creator references, fingerprints/revisions and recovery status; preserve idempotency

families.family: Local Person and automatically initialized Ledger
families.owner: Existing Trip initializer and Ledger owning repositories
families.localBinding: local_trip_ledger_bindings links Guest local owner to ledger_journeys, ledger_members and ledger_actor_context; other Ledger rows need owning scope proof
families.A: Trip initializer creates local creator Person and default Ledger state even though Ledger UI is not wired in A
families.B: Do not omit automatic Ledger/Person state. Reconcile all stable references and actual financial rows per owning contract; never infer Guest ownership for unscoped canonical Account rows

families.owner: Existing Manual Flight/Stay/Rental/Transport/Activity and Core repositories
families.A: Chooser disabled for Guest in A; existing Account behavior retained
families.B: Obtain owning-family inventory before activation; do not assume empty or discard any retained records; do not rebuild Forms

families.family: Capture, Documents, sources, reviews and attachments
families.owner: Universal Import Capture/Source/Documents lane and existing file stores
families.localBinding: Existing account-scoped inbox/payload/submission/source records and explicit owning file references; Guest access not assembled in A
families.A: Not wired; no Guest photo/capture file-store access or cloud upload
families.B: Inventory batches/candidates/reviews/originals/receipts and exact file hashes/byte counts with owning port; no Account cache reclassification, no SQLite/Keychain/Token copying, no uploads before complete server preflight

families.owner: Owning forms/repositories and existing durable queues
families.localBinding: Manual P1 draft is currently bound to the owning repository instance via WeakMap; committed intents live in existing SQLite queues
families.A: Unsaved draft is not a durable business save; normal Cancel guards retained; committed Trip/P1 cold recovery still requires actual Native evidence
families.B: Inventory both live drafts and durable pending intents; preserve originating screen/intent on failed or cancelled login. A SQLite-only census is insufficient; never silently clear live drafts at handoff

families.owner: Auth/Profile lane and existing device preferences
families.A: Guest local marker and optional Trip creator nickname are not an Account profile. Profile/AKA editing remains later approved work
families.B: Inventory any supported local Guest profile through owning ports; never infer connection from name/email/AKA. Device language/theme and temporary UI state are not all Account-cloud sync data

families.owner: Existing TripViewContext and Account bookmark repository
families.A: Guest Day context remains in memory; no Account SecureStore bookmark list or record and no Guest UUID in Account keys
families.B: Guest cold reading-position persistence is not claimed. Preserve actual business Trip/P1 data independently of this temporary UI hint

nonGuestExclusions: Other Account files or unscoped legacy records without explicit ownership proof
retention: Keep Guest originals until verified atomic whole-dataset publication. No two editable workspaces, partial visible migration or data deletion on cancellation/failure/UNKNOWN.
beforeB: Complete Golden A normal Native Trip/P1/Day/cold acceptance
Build real full-dataset inventory through owning repositories, including live UI drafts and files
Define/review missing server-authoritative full-dataset preflight, staging/publish receipt and UNKNOWN status ports; keep protected authority closed until exact applicable Gate is satisfied
